<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex21032024-09-0412-46-27" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon"><milestone unit="section" n="Colophon (55a5-55a7)"/><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3913">bdag</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3913">shag kya'i dge slong prad nya badz+ra</rs></note><note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3829">dge ba'i bshes pu to ba</rs>'i slob ma <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3913">rnal 'byor pa shes rab rdo rje</rs>s mdzad pa yin no</note> gis <note type="gloss">ti ka</note> de bsdebs <note type="gloss">ba las byung ba'i</note> dge ba gang <note type="gloss">zhig</note> thob <note type="gloss">pa</note> des ||
         phyin chad skyes bu <note type="gloss">bdag gzhan gyi don dang tshig don gyi rtogs pa</note> don <note type="gloss">du</note> gnyer <note type="gloss">bar</note> 'dod pa yis ||<lb n="55a7"/> bden pa gnyis ston <note type="gloss">pa'i</note>tshig dang <note type="gloss">des bstan pa'i</note> don rtogs <note type="gloss">par gyur</note> nas ||<note type="gloss">thabs dang shes rab du su 'jug pa ||
                     </note> dbu ma'i lam gyis nges <note type="gloss">pa ste gdon mi za bar</note> par <note type="gloss">chos kyi</note> sku thob <note type="gloss">par</note> shog <note type="gloss">1</note>|| dge'o ||</seg></TEI>
